title: Example App — Application Privacy Notice
summary: Application-specific supplement to the ROO Secure Master Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 1. Application Operator
sections.body: Replace this section with the exact legal entity that operates this application and state whether it acts as controller, joint controller or processor for each relevant processing activity.

sections.heading: 2. Application Data
sections.body: Replace this section with the exact categories collected by the application, including account data, device data, diagnostics, photos/files, location, contacts, analytics, crash logs and security telemetry as applicable.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Services
sections.body: List every material SDK, analytics provider, crash-reporting provider, payment processor, CAPTCHA provider, advertising/remarketing provider, hosting provider and other processor actually used by the application.

sections.heading: 4. Retention
sections.body: Insert actual retention periods or documented criteria for each material category.

sections.heading: 5. Rights and Requests
sections.body: Requests can be directed to privacy@roosecure.com unless the application has a different designated privacy contact.

sections.heading: 6. Relationship to Master Policy
sections.body: This notice supplements the ROO Secure Master Privacy Policy. If there is a conflict, the application-specific notice controls only to the extent necessary to accurately describe that application's processing, subject to the applicable legal agreement.
